_doc: What each joined channel is, and so how strictly its posts are screened (telegram_ingest.py). role: official = a party's own statements, kept as attributed claims; local = fast local reporting; outlet = a news organisation; aggregator = OSINT reposting, kept only with a photo or video; partisan = aligned aggregator, same rule plus a label. A channel not listed is treated as an aggregator. ignore = joined but not read (quotes, tributes, no events). Official channels are statements: never map pins; in the Inbox, cited on events, and notified when they claim an attack. read_for: announcements = read mainly for what it says WILL happen (dated gatherings and actions → /api/telegram/upcoming); every channel's posts are read for announcements too. join: true = the server joins this channel itself (two a pass, telegram_ingest._join_registered); checked to exist and post before it was added.
